name: Gurave Sarva Lokanam
text:
गुरवे सर्वलोकानां भिषजे भवरोगिणाम् ।
निधये सर्वविद्यानां दक्षिणामूर्तये नमः ॥
meaning: Salutations to the teacher of all worlds, the healer of the troubles of existence and the storehouse of all knowledge, Dakshinamurti.
purpose: A praise verse for wisdom and the teacher principle.
supports: Learning; humility; seeking counsel; clarity when facing complex questions.
when: Before study, teaching or a period of reflection.
